caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a coat or robe, set against a plain, light beige background. The coat is brown in color and features a loose, wide-sleeved design that extends to about mid-thigh length. The front opening, sleeve ends, and lower hem of the coat are adorned with intricate trim that is predominantly red, with decorative patterns in additional colors such as green and white. The trim down the front and at the collar is scalloped and contains geometric and floral motifs, as does the trim along the bottom edge. The interior of the coat is not visible, and the coat is rendered in a realistic style with shading to suggest texture and folds in the fabric. The coat is centrally placed within the composition, and there are signs of aging, such as slight discoloration, visible on the background paper.
title: Dark Brown Cotton Coat
